customers.subtitle: {count} people have ordered from you

customers.empty_all: Customers appear here once you have orders.

account.subtitle: Your name, email, language and password. These follow you across every store.
account.name: Name
account.email_hint: If you change it, we send a link to confirm the new one.
speech.no_voice: This device has no voice for this language. Install one in your system settings.

speech.error_no_speech: I didn’t hear anything. Tap the mic and try again.

speech.error_failed: Voice typing stopped. Try again, or type your question.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Your AI team proposes; nothing that spends money or changes prices runs until you say yes.
approvals.rule_act: Spending, price changes, refunds and publishing always wait for a person.
approvals.rule_edit: Edit a proposal before approving; the AI keeps your changes.
approvals.rule_limit: Managers approve up to their limit; larger amounts go to the owner.
approvals.rule_log: Every decision is kept in the activity log with who decided.
categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Group products so shoppers find them in the menu and filters.
categories.list_hint: Drag to set the order shoppers see.
categories.f_order: Drag and drop to reorder the storefront menu.
categories.f_bilingual: Arabic and English names, each with its own link.
categories.f_slug: Clean links, with a redirect when you rename.
categories.f_hide: Hide a category without deleting its products.
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: How much you have, how long it lasts, and when to reorder.
inventory.table_hint: Days of stock use the last 30 days of sales.
inventory.f_variants: Stock per size and colour, not just per product.
inventory.f_cover: Days of stock from your real sales pace.
inventory.f_alert: Your AI COO warns you before a best-seller runs out.
inventory.f_adjust: Count, receive and adjust stock with a reason.
returns.title: Returns
returns.subtitle: Requests from shoppers, what came back, and what was refunded.
returns.f_request: Shoppers request a return from their order page.
returns.f_restock: Received items go back into stock automatically.
returns.f_refund: Refund to card or wallet, or as store credit.
returns.f_ledger: Every refund reverses the sale in your books.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Who visits, where they come from, and what they buy. Revenue comes from your books.
analytics.chart_label: Daily sales for the last 14 days, rising towards today. Total {total} EGP.
analytics.demand_hint: Ranked by purchases, with products people want but can't get.
marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.subtitle: What you spend to bring shoppers in, what it earns, and the tools on your store.
marketing.pixels_hint: Paste an ID; they load only after the shopper accepts cookies.
marketing.tools_hint: Small tools that turn visitors into buyers.
marketing.tool_welcome_hint: A first-order code for new visitors.
marketing.tool_whatsapp_hint: Chat with you from any page.
campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Your Meta campaigns, judged by the orders they really brought to your store.
campaigns.list_hint: Last 7 days. Sales are matched to your orders, not Meta's estimate.
campaigns.f_connect: Read-only link to your Meta ad account.
campaigns.f_match: Orders matched to campaigns through UTM tags and event IDs.
campaigns.f_verdict: A verdict for each campaign, with the reason in plain words.
campaigns.f_propose: New campaign ideas from what shoppers view but don't buy.
campaigns.f_approve: Proposals wait for you; you launch them in Ads Manager.
discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.subtitle: Codes shoppers type at checkout.
discounts.f_types: Percentage, fixed amount or free shipping.
discounts.f_limits: Minimum order, expiry date and usage limit.
discounts.f_margin: The AI never proposes a discount below your margin.
abandoned.title: Abandoned checkouts
abandoned.subtitle: Shoppers who gave their phone but didn't finish. One message often brings them back.
seo.title: SEO
seo.subtitle: How easily Google and AI search find your store, and what to fix first.
seo.issues_hint: Most important first. Your AI CTO drafts the fixes for you to approve.
seo.files_hint: Generated for every store and kept up to date.
seo.search_console_hint: See the searches that bring shoppers to you.
seo.search_console_body: Verify your store once; we import top queries daily.
builder.title: Store builder
builder.subtitle: Pages made of sections. Edit them yourself or describe what you want to your AI team.

builder.f_sections: Hero, product grids, banners, reviews, FAQ and more.
builder.f_edit: Add, hide, reorder and edit sections with a live preview.
builder.f_chat: Describe your business; the Store Builder drafts pages and products.
builder.f_draft: AI changes arrive as drafts; nothing goes live until you approve.
builder.f_versions: Every publish is a version you can restore.
theme.title: Theme
theme.subtitle: Colours, fonts and shapes for your storefront.
theme.shape_hint: Square, soft or round buttons and cards.
media.title: Media
media.subtitle: Every image and video in your store, in one place.
media.library_hint: Images are resized and converted to WebP automatically.
finance.title: Finance
finance.subtitle: Profit, cash and what's coming, straight from your books.
finance.source: Source: your ledger. Every figure the AI quotes comes from here.
finance.forecast_hint: Next 3 months at your current pace.
finance.breakeven_body: You cover all costs after {amount} in monthly sales.
reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Statements for any period, ready for your accountant.
expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Rent, salaries, packaging: everything sales don't record for you.
expenses.close_hint: A closed month can't change, only be reversed.
budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: Plan each month, see where you're over, and test ideas before you try them.
budgets.whatif_hint: Try a price change on this month.
budgets.whatif_note: Assumes about 1.2% fewer orders for each 1% higher price.
ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.subtitle: Every sale, refund and expense as a double-entry record.
ledger.journal_hint: Posted automatically from orders, payments and expenses.
settings.subtitle: Your store's name, language and who can see it.
a11y.title: Accessibility and display
a11y.subtitle: Make Minivora easier to read and calmer to use. Changes apply right away.
a11y.text_size_hint: Text, buttons and spacing grow together.
a11y.comfort_hint: These also turn on by themselves when your device asks for them.
a11y.motion_hint: Stop drifting backgrounds, smooth scrolling and page animations.
a11y.transparency_hint: Solid cards instead of frosted glass, and no glowing background.
a11y.contrast_hint: Darker secondary text and visible borders.
a11y.links_hint: So links don't rely on colour alone.
a11y.language_hint: Arabic or English, saved on your account.
payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: How shoppers pay you. Gateways run in test mode in version 1.0.

payments.m_kashier_hint: Visa, Mastercard, Meeza and mobile wallets.
payments.m_instapay_hint: Shopper uploads the receipt; you confirm it.
payments.m_fawry_hint: Pay with a reference code at any Fawry outlet.
payments.safety_body: Card details never touch Minivora. Every payment notice is checked by signature and counted once.
shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.subtitle: Fees and delivery times per governorate.
domain.title: Domain
domain.subtitle: Where shoppers find your store.

domain.step2: We check it and issue a certificate.
domain.step3: Your store moves to the new address; old links redirect.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.subtitle: What you're told about, where, and when to stay quiet.

visitors.sources_soon: Traffic sources shown here once tracking starts
